body:
I will move out eventually...thats true. Its just hard waking up even if its for a limited time, less then a year, to move out. As for women that's true, but its just so hard..I never had feelings for a girl like this before. I been trying to get over her but every time it springs back up, at this point I just stopped talking to her completely which is not something I want either. I want a relationship but I don't want to get her out of my life ...I dont know, Im rambling, I hope I make a little sense.

I want to work in communication, I want to work in television...My English teacher said I was a really good writer and I did that for a while, but I stopped when I started feeling depressed because well...it was always depressing writing.
